role.title: Chief Operational Technology Officer
role.description: DRAFT. OT specialization of NICE work role OG-WRL-007 (Executive Cybersecurity Leadership). The executive accountable for the security and resilience of the organization's operational technology: sets OT cybersecurity strategy, governance and risk tolerance, and makes sure security is built into operations, engineering, capital projects and procurement. Some organizations give this to a CISO or a VP of operations or engineering.
role.overlaps_method: Computed: NICE roles sharing the most statements with this role, excluding the roles it extends.

citations.note: Parent NICE role; all its statements are inherited.
Security program requirements for asset owners.

open_questions: Is this a distinct executive role, or a set of OT duties added to the CISO (OG-WRL-007)?
Who owns OT security in practice: operations, engineering, or IT security? The answer shapes the core list.

modules.objective: Execute containment and recovery steps with process continuity and safety constraints.
Identify MBAP header length anomalies in Modbus TCP traffic
Recognize a ENIP command and its direct physical consequence.
Analyze CIP service codes to detect unauthorized controller state manipulation.
Identify adversarial TTPs used for device fingerprinting via ENIP.
Deeply understand Modbus/TCP addressing and protocol offsets.
Identify DNP3 Transport Layer fragment anomalies.
Reconstruct an adversary timeline to identify unauthorized control nodes and tampered ENIP/CIP setpoints.
Identify adversarial TTPs for Profinet network discovery.
Identify the missing field in a truncated (Partial) MBAP header.
Identify a DNP3 Link Layer length field anomaly.
Perform packet analysis to reconstruct a multi-state control change.
